occurrences.text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Cesar? unto Cesar shalt thou go.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
